asset.description: One retractable current recorded-state per post-activation Medusa order; reference approximation only.
asset.time_basis: current_state_after_last_consumed_kafka_offset; observed_state_at is not order placement time
asset.authority: Derived from allowlisted committed Medusa CDC rows; not native order.placed authority.
quality_requirements: Check mapper and sink lag before a current-state claim.
limitations: No historical conversion, amount, revenue, payment, shipment, or funnel completion claim.

metric.display_name: Đơn hiện được ghi nhận (tham chiếu)
metric.formula: COUNT(*) WHERE active = true GROUP BY source_instance_id
metric.time_basis: current state at the sink's last applied Kafka offset; not an occurrence-time window
metric.aggregation_rule: count active rows at unique source_instance_id + order_id grain
minimum_data_requirements: Post-activation CDC coverage and complete ordered mapper END prefix.
quality_requirements: Show approximation and coverage labels; block authoritative or finalized conversion claims.
